question: What is your return policy?
patterns: product wapis karna ho to kya karun
agar product pasand na aye to kya karen
answer: You can return items within 30 days of receiving your order. Please keep the item unused, in its original packaging, and include your order details. Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we will process your refund or guide you about an exchange if that is what you prefer.

question: How long does shipping take?
patterns: shipping kitni der me hoti hai
mera order kab tak deliver hoga
answer: Shipping usually takes 3-5 business days after your order is confirmed. Delivery time can vary a little depending on your city, courier load, public holidays, or weather conditions. When your order is shipped, you should receive tracking details so you can follow the parcel status.

question: Do you offer international shipping?
patterns: kya ap pakistan se bahir ship karte hain
bahar mulk order bhej sakte ho
dusre country me parcel bhejte ho
answer: Yes, we offer international shipping to many countries. Shipping charges and delivery time depend on the destination country and courier service. Customs duty, import taxes, or local clearance charges may apply in some countries, and those are usually handled by the customer.

question: How can I contact support?
patterns: help chahiye kis se baat karun
support ka number ya email batao
answer: You can contact support by emailing support@example.com. Please include your name, order number, and a clear explanation of the issue so the team can help faster. If your question is about delivery, also share any tracking number you have.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: After your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking number or tracking link. Open that link to see the latest parcel status. If the tracking has not updated yet, wait a few hours because courier systems sometimes take time to refresh. If it still does not update, contact support with your order number.

question: Can I change or cancel my order?
patterns: order me item change kar sakta hun
answer: You can request a change or cancellation as soon as possible after placing the order. If the order has not been packed or shipped yet, support can usually help update the address, change details, or cancel it. Once the parcel is shipped, changes may not be possible and you may need to follow the return process after delivery.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
patterns: card se pay kar sakta hun
answer: We accept common payment methods such as online payment and cash on delivery where available. The exact options may depend on your location and the checkout settings. If a payment fails, try again after checking your card or account details, or contact support for help.

question: What should I do if I receive a damaged or wrong item?
patterns: complaint karni hai damaged order ki
jo order kia tha wo nahi aya
answer: If you receive a damaged, defective, or wrong item, contact support as soon as possible. Share your order number, clear photos or video of the item, and packaging if possible. The team will review the issue and guide you about replacement, exchange, or refund based on the case.
